title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Aug. 10
title_cn: 8 月 10 日最新石油市场新闻和分析
summary: Oil embarked on a steady climb higher as Iran and Oman remained short of a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, while European diesel prices surged following an attack on a Saudi Arabian refinery near the Red Sea.

title: IBM Raises C$2.75 Billion in First Canada Bond Sale Since 2012
title_cn: IBM 自 2012 年以来首次发行加拿大债券筹集了 27.5 亿加元
summary: International Business Machines Corp. sold C$2.75 billion ($1.97 billion) of Canadian corporate bonds Monday, building on a record year of issuance in the currency by foreign firms.

title: Iran Doing Good Job of Rattling Trump, Says Bernard Haykel
title_cn: 伯纳德·海克尔表示，伊朗在激怒特朗普方面做得很好
summary: Professor Bernard Haykel said that President Trump has to be much cooler around negotiations with Iran, as the Iran's government is succeeding at 'rattling' the US president. Haykel, who teaches at Princeton, said that Iran cannot keep sole control of the Strait of Hormuz because that would let them keep the world 'over a barrel.'  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Fed’s Hammack Says ‘Some Number’ of Rate Hikes May Be Needed
title_cn: 美联储哈马克表示可能需要“一定程度”的加息
summary: Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland President Beth Hammack said it’s possible a number of interest rate hikes may be needed to bring inflation down to the central bank’s 2% target, but she does not want to prejudge what the end point will be.

title: US Natural Gas Surges as Hotter Outlooks Trigger Short-Covering
title_cn: 前景转暖引发空头回补，美国天然气价格飙升
summary: US natural gas futures closed higher, earlier rising by the most in more than two months, as an unusually large swing in weather forecasts triggered a wave of short-covering among money managers who were the most bearish on gas since 2020.

title: Yen Weakens 1%, Erases Half of US-Japan Intervention Gains
title_cn: 日元贬值1%，美日干预收益抹去一半
summary: The yen extended its losses, erasing half of the gains triggered when authorities from the US and Japan intervened in the foreign-exchange market to support the currency.

title: Test Your ETF Knowledge In Our IQ Test
title_cn: 在我们的 IQ 测试中测试您的 ETF 知识
summary: Bloomberg's Isabelle Lee puts Eric Balchunas, Jon Maier, chief ETF strategist for JPMorgan Asset Management, and Mayuranki De, vice president of ETF trade strategy at Raymond James, to the test on "Bloomberg ETF IQ" in this week's edition of "IQ Test." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Deadly Earthquake Hits Colombia
title_cn: 哥伦比亚发生致命地震
summary:
A deadly earthquake hit Colombia on Monday morning, toppling buildings, burying people under rubble and causing dozens of deaths in the Pacific region and the central Andes.

 (Source: Bloomberg)

title: JBS Returns Leadership to Batista Clan as Scion Named Next CEO
title_cn: JBS 将领导权交还给 Batista 家族，Scion 被任命为下一任首席执行官
summary: The world’s largest meat supplier, JBS NV, will be led once again by a member of Brazil’s Batista family, a pivotal move for a global food powerhouse that’s increasingly focused on the US.

title: Avantis ETF Cracks Small-Cap Code
title_cn: Avantis ETF 破解小盘股代码
summary: Eduardo Repetto, CIO of Avantis Investors, joins Isabelle Lee and Eric Balchunas on "Bloomberg ETF IQ." They discus the Avantis U.S. Small Cap Value (ticker: AVUV). (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Chile Gives Struggling Copper Giant Codelco a $2.4 Billion Boost
title_cn: 智利向陷入困境的铜业巨头Codelco提供24亿美元的援助
summary: Chile’s government will allow state-owned Codelco to retain all of its 2025 profit, leaving about $2.42 billion in the copper giant as it looks to revive production and ease a record debt burden.

summary:

 (Source: Bloomberg)

summary: A performing arts school in the heart of Los Angeles is planning to borrow $117 million in the municipal bond market on Tuesday, marking the largest private school deal in two years.

title: Shipping Traffic Is Up Despite War in Iran, Says FreightWaves CEO
title_cn: FreightWaves 首席执行官表示，尽管伊朗发生战争，航运量仍在增加
summary: Craig Fuller, CEO of FreightWaves, sees stronger trucking, rail and container volumes despite higher shipping and insurance costs because of the war in Iran. He also talks about a new shipping route that is being used to get through the Arctic to avoid the Strait of Hormuz. Fuller speaks on "Bloomberg Open Interest." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Saudis Delay Restart of Jazan Plant to Late August, IIR Says
title_cn: IIR 表示，沙特将吉赞工厂的重启时间推迟至 8 月底
summary: Saudi Aramco pushed back restarting its Jazan oil refinery to late August, following a weekend attack on the facility, according to market intelligence firm IIR Energy.

title: Wheat Climbs With USDA Seen Tightening Global Grain Supply
title_cn: 美国农业部预计全球粮食供应趋紧，小麦价格上涨
summary: Wheat was higher as traders braced for the US Department of Agriculture’s monthly supply demand report that’s expected to show declining domestic and world grain supplies.

title: The Other Way to Reduce Government Debt
title_cn: 减少政府债务的另一种方法
summary: Financial repression.

title: US Stocks ‘Directionless’ as Chipmaker Earnings, CPI to Set Pace
title_cn: 芯片制造商盈利、消费者物价指数跟随美国股市“毫无方向”
summary: US stocks were looking for direction after a strong earnings week as investors continue to navigate the uncertain path of interest rates and war in Iran. The market is gearing up for the final stretch of corporate earnings, with chipmakers set to provide confirmation for the long-winded debate over valuations.

title: Iran’s Oil Terminals Look Idle as US Keeps Up Naval Blockade
title_cn: 由于美国继续进行海军封锁，伊朗的石油码头看起来闲置
summary: Iran’s oil terminals have appeared largely idle this month as the US continues to impose a blockade aimed at pressuring the country into a peace deal, though visibility into its operations remains patchy.

title: Investor ETF Appeal Of Photonics
title_cn: 光子学ETF对投资者的吸引力
summary: Mayuranki De, vice president of ETF Trade Strategy at Raymond James, joins Isabelle Lee and Eric Balchunas on "Bloomberg ETF IQ." They discuss the Roundhill Photonics & Optics ETF (ticker: LYTE), an actively managed ETF that seeks to provide capital appreciation. The Fund invests in the equity securities of companies whose core technology involves generating, manipulating, detecting, or transmitting light for various technologies, such as AI data centers, defense, medical imaging, industrial manufacturing, and quantum computing. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: OpenAI Is Hiring a Power-Trading Lead for Its Data Center Portfolio
title_cn: OpenAI 正在为其数据中心产品组合聘请电力交易主管
summary: OpenAI is hiring a power-trading lead to help manage the expanding energy needs of the electricity-intensive data centers running its artificial intelligence models.

title: 'Overwhelming Demand' for Crypto ETFs: Mitchnick
title_cn: 米奇尼克：对加密 ETF 的“压倒性需求”
summary: Robert Mitchnick, head of digital assets at BlackRock, joins Isabelle Lee and Eric Balchunas on "Bloomberg ETF IQ." Hackers have stolen more than $130 million worth of Bitcoin from thousands of supposedly secure cold wallets in recent days. The Coldcard wallet hack may strengthen the case for spot Bitcoin ETFs by undermining confidence in self-custody among investors. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: ETFs Offer 'Trusted Vehicle' for Bitcoin: Mitchnick
title_cn: ETF 为比特币提供“值得信赖的工具”：米奇尼克
summary: Robert Mitchnick, head of digital assets at BlackRock, joins Isabelle Lee and Eric Balchunas on "Bloomberg ETF IQ." Hackers have stolen more than $130 million worth of Bitcoin from thousands of supposedly secure cold wallets in recent days. The Coldcard wallet hack may strengthen the case for spot Bitcoin ETFs by undermining confidence in self-custody among investors. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Meta Brings Powerful AI to the Personal Computer
title_cn: Meta 为个人电脑带来强大的人工智能
summary: Meta is escalating the debate over open versus closed AI with Muse Glimmer, a new downloadable model designed to run on a personal computer using a single GPU. The release, accompanied by a new essay from CEO Mark Zuckerberg, underscores Meta's push for more accessible and customizable AI as low-cost open models from China intensify pressure on rivals including OpenAI and Anthropic. Bloomberg's Kurt Wagner joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: South Park Commons Raises Ambitions for the AI Era
title_cn: South Park Commons 提出人工智能时代的雄心
summary: South Park Commons is expanding its investment strategy as AI pushes founders toward increasingly ambitious and capital-intensive ideas. Co-founder and General Partner Aditya Agarwal joins Bloomberg to discuss the firm’s “minus one to zero” approach to backing entrepreneurs before their ideas fully take shape, why its new fund will allow it to write bigger checks and invest for longer, and how early bets on founders like Cognition CEO Scott Wu are shaping its strategy. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: From Coding to Finance: Microsoft’s AI Agent Push
title_cn: 从编码到金融：微软的AI代理推送
summary: Microsoft says AI agents are already fundamentally changing how its software engineers work — and sales, finance and other knowledge workers are next. Charles Lamanna, Microsoft EVP of Copilot, Agents and Platform, joins Bloomberg to explain how employees are shifting from doing tasks themselves to overseeing AI agents, why the company sees the technology driving more productivity rather than simply reducing headcount, and what’s behind Microsoft 365 Copilot’s surge past 30 million paid seats. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: GameStop Rethinks Its eBay Play
title_cn: GameStop 重新思考其 eBay 策略
summary: GameStop is considering dropping its bid for eBay and pursuing a partnership instead, according to sources. Bloomberg’s Bailey Lipschultz and Spencer Soper explain how GameStop CEO Ryan Cohen could seek to leverage its 1,600 US stores to give eBay a physical retail presence - and why a partnership may prove more realistic than an outright deal. They join Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Baillie Gifford’s McPadden Backs TSMC, SK Hynix Over China Chips
title_cn: Baillie Gifford 的 McPadden 支持台积电和 SK 海力士购买中国芯片
summary: Baillie Gifford & Co.’s Paulina McPadden said companies like Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. and SK Hynix Inc. hold near-monopoly positions in advanced chip manufacturing that China will struggle to match, even as Beijing mobilizes its stock and bond market to fund its AI ambitions.

title: Intel Raises Cash, Apple Gets Downgraded | Bloomberg Tech 8/10/2026
title_cn: 英特尔筹集现金，苹果降级 |彭博科技 2026 年 8 月 10 日
summary: Bloomberg’s Ed Ludlow breaks down Intel's decision to tap the market for $15 billion in fresh capital, betting renewed AI enthusiasm can help fund its push into chips and physical AI. Plus, Apple gets a rare downgrade from Jefferies on concerns about its iPhone roadmap, and Microsoft explains how AI agents are already transforming the way software gets built. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: How Can China Win the AI Race Against the US?
title_cn: 中国如何才能赢得与美国的人工智能竞赛？
summary: As the US-China AI race intensifies, investors are weighing not only access to chips and capital, but which companies have competitive advantages that can endure for decades. Paulina McPadden, investment manager of International Concentrated Growth Strategy at Baillie Gifford, discusses why she “wouldn’t want to bet against China” and the durable moats she sees at TSMC, SK Hynix and ASML. She also discusses how companies like Shopify and MercadoLibre are emerging as AI beneficiaries outside the semiconductor industry. She joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Stocks Drift as Inflation Looms; Intel Makes $15B AI Bet | Open Interest 8/10/2026
title_cn: 通胀逼近，股市下跌；英特尔押注 15B 美元人工智能 |未平仓合约 8/10/2026
summary: Get a jump start on the US trading day with Vonnie Quinn on "Bloomberg Open Interest." Intel is offering $15 billion in common stock as it races to capitalize on booming AI demand. Oil advances as President Trump turns up the financial pressure on Iran, while Tehran rejects talks. And stocks hover near record highs ahead of the latest inflation data due later this week. Plus, GameStop may withdraw its $56 billion bid for eBay, Berkshire Hathaway CEO Greg Abel puts cash to work, and FreightWaves CEO Craig Fuller discusses Amazon's push into trucking. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Nvidia to Team With Wall Street on $500 Billion Funding Package
title_cn: Nvidia 将与华尔街联手提供 5000 亿美元融资计划
summary: A group of US investment giants are nearing a partnership with Nvidia Corp. on $500 billion in funding for the buildout of AI infrastructure, according to people familiar with the matter.

title: Chinese Rocket Fails While Launching Communications Satellite
title_cn: 中国火箭在发射通信卫星时失败
summary: A Chinese Long March rocket failed while launching a communications satellite on Monday, China’s state media reported, marking the second failure of the rocket family this year.

title: GameStop’s Cohen Said to Weigh Pulling $56 Billion EBay Bid
title_cn: GameStop 的科恩称正在考虑撤回 560 亿美元的 eBay 竞标
summary: GameStop, led by Chief Executive Officer Ryan Cohen, is considering withdrawing its $56 billion bid for eBay Inc., according to people familiar with the matter. Bloomberg's Bailey Lipshultz joins to discuss this as well as how Switch filed confidentially for a US IPO, joining its data center peers in tapping demand for exposure to the artificial intelligence theme. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Meta Loses Last Minute Bid to Pause Landmark State AGs Trial
title_cn: Meta 在暂停地标州 AG 审判的最后一刻失败
summary: Meta Platforms Inc. failed to obtain an emergency order pausing a landmark trial slated to begin this week involving claims from dozens of state attorneys general alleging the social media giant addicts children and has caused a youth mental health crisis.

title: Apple Downgraded at Jefferies on iPhone Outlook
title_cn: 杰富瑞 (Jefferies) 下调苹果 iPhone 展望评级
summary: Apple is no longer the "king of the supply chain," and that has Jefferies analyst Edison Lee worried. He cut Apple from hold to underperform and lowered the price target to $263.66 from $285.56. Lee says introducing new form factors in the iPhone is harder than expected and plans for an all-glass iPhone model were cancelled. He speaks to Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Microsoft to Boost AI Chip Production, Information Says
title_cn: 消息称微软将提高人工智能芯片产量
summary: Microsoft is planning to “significantly” increase production of its next-generation AI chips, the Information reported. Bloomberg's Anurag Rana joins Bloomberg Intelligence to discuss this as well as how Apple is considering an overhaul to its smartwatch lineup in light of the industry’s transition to screen-free devices and other new form factors. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Intel to Sell $15 Billion in Stock After AI Boosts Demand
title_cn: 人工智能提振需求后英特尔将出售 150 亿美元股票
summary: Intel Corp. plans to offer $15 billion worth of new stock in what may be its first public share sale since the chipmaker listed in 1971, a bid to extend its comeback and capitalize on the AI boom.

title: GameStop CEO May Pull $56 Billion EBay Bid
title_cn: GameStop 首席执行官可能会撤回 560 亿美元的 eBay 收购要约
summary: GameStop Corp. may pull its $56 billion bid for EBay according to people familiar with the matter. GameStop CEO Ryan Cohen may instead propose a partnership. Bloomberg's Bailey Lipschultz reports.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Trump Signals Restraint on Iran | Balance of Power 8/10/2026
title_cn: 特朗普发出对伊朗保持克制的信号权力平衡 2026 年 8 月 10 日
summary: On the early edition of Balance of Power, Bloomberg Washington Correspondent Joe Mathieu discusses the latest from the Middle East. On today's show, Democratic Congresswoman Suzan DelBene of Washington, Stonecourt Capital Partner Rick Davis, Harvard Kennedy School Ash Center Visiting Democracy Fellow Jeanne Sheehan Zaino and Princeton University Professor Bernard Haykel. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Trump Ready to Let Economic Pressure Build on Iran
title_cn: 特朗普准备对伊朗施加经济压力
summary: President Donald Trump says he's ready to let economic pressure build on Iran. He also says the country should pay for damages it has caused to neighbors. Bloomberg's Josh Wingrove reports from the White House. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Democrat Candidates Aren't 'Cookie Cutter,' Says DCCC Chair DelBene
title_cn: DCCC 主席德尔贝内表示，民主党候选人并非“千篇一律”
summary: Representative Suzan DelBene, who heads the Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee, said Democratic candidates aren't 'cookie-cutter' and that they reflect their communities and the issues that matter to voters in their home districts. DelBene said that the path to winning back the house runs through purple districts around the country and that candidates running in those districts have 'crossover appeal.' (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Can Trump Influence the Federal Reserve and Interest Rates?
title_cn: 特朗普能影响美联储和利率吗？
summary: Since the start of his second term, President Donald Trump has waged a fierce campaign to impose his will on the Federal Reserve, breaking with the modern convention of walling off the US central bank from political interference, at least publicly. He sought to pressure Jerome Powell, the Fed chairman Trump appointed during his first presidential term, to cut interest rates. And he has attempted to push another Fed governor, Lisa Cook, from her job.

title: Trump Wins Permission to Remove Brand Damage From BBC Suit
title_cn: 特朗普获得许可消除 BBC 诉讼中的品牌损害
summary: President Donald Trump won permission to revise his $10 billion defamation lawsuit against the British Broadcasting Corp. by excluding his earlier claim that a 12-second clip in a documentary caused massive financial damage to his business.

title: Trump Lashes Out After Iranian Demands as Deal Hopes Dim
title_cn: 协议希望渺茫，特朗普猛烈抨击伊朗的要求
summary: US President Donald Trump lashed out on Monday against Iran’s demands for war compensation as part of talks to wind down the conflict, dimming hopes of a quick deal that would reopen the vital Strait of Hormuz and pushing up oil prices.

title: Russia Bars Anti-War Yabloko Party From Parliamentary Elections
title_cn: 俄罗斯禁止反战亚布洛科党参加议会选举
summary: Russia’s Supreme Court blocked the Yabloko party from appearing on the ballot in September’s elections to the lower house of parliament, effectively banning one of the country’s few political blocs openly calling for an end to the fighting in Ukraine.

title: Trump Extends Narrowed Waiver of US Jones Act Shipping Mandates
title_cn: 特朗普延长了美国《琼斯法案》航运授权的狭窄豁免
summary: President Donald Trump has extended a waiver allowing foreign ships to transport oil and other commodities around the US for 90 more days, albeit with new limits, as the war in Iran disrupts crude flows and hikes fuel costs.

title: Netanyahu Rejects Hamas Disarmament Proposal Touted by Trump
title_cn: 内塔尼亚胡拒绝特朗普吹捧的哈马斯解除武装提议
summary:
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu rejected a proposal by US-backed mediators for disarming Hamas, hardening his position after voicing misgivings at the suggestion that Israel reciprocate with phased pullouts from Gaza.
Dan Williams, Bloomberg News Middle East Reporter, discusses the latest moves from conflict in the Middle East. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Ossoff Looks Beyond Senate Foe to Blast Trump in Georgia Speech
title_cn: 奥索夫在佐治亚州的演讲中超越了参议院的敌人抨击特朗普
summary: US Senator Jon Ossoff delivered a blistering attack on Donald Trump from a Black pulpit near Atlanta, casting his gaze beyond his Senate opponent to the US president as the Georgia Democrat campaigns for a second term this November.

title: Ukraine Hits Big Oil Refinery, Petchem Plant Deep in Russia
title_cn: 乌克兰袭击俄罗斯深处的大型炼油厂和石油化工工厂
summary: Ukraine’s military attacked the large Taneco oil refinery and the ZapSibNeftekhim petrochemical plant deep inside Russia on Monday, adding to the pressure on the country’s downstream industry.

title: Trump Adopts 'Low-Key' Approach to Iran Talks
title_cn: 特朗普对伊朗谈判采取“低调”态度
summary: President Donald Trump has shifted from touting an imminent peace deal with Iran to adopting a “low key” attitude to negotiations. Bloomberg's Abeer Abu Omar reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Trump Signals Restraint on Iran, Favors Economic Pressure
title_cn: 特朗普暗示对伊朗实施克制，有利于经济施压
summary: US President Donald Trump signaled he’s prepared to let economic pressure on Iran build rather than launch fresh military strikes to force a reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, even as the Islamic Republic reiterated that the conditions still aren’t in place to allow free passage through the key waterway.

title: Republicans in Congress Face Mountain of To-Dos Before Midterms
title_cn: 国会中的共和党人在中期选举前面临着堆积如山的待办事项
summary: GOP leaders will need to pick and choose how to use limited business days this fall.

title: China Hits US Pecans With 54% Levies Before Xi-Trump Summit
title_cn: 习近平与特朗普峰会前，中国对美国山核桃征收54%的关税
summary: China ordered steep anti-dumping deposits on pecan imports from the US and Mexico, adding another source of trade friction weeks before an expected summit between President Donald Trump and Chinese leader Xi Jinping.

title: India Seeks to Curb States’ Powers to Tax Minerals, Mining
title_cn: 印度寻求限制各州对矿产、采矿业征税的权力
summary: India’s federal government plans to curb states’ powers to regulate or tax mineral rights and ore-bearing land, seeking to make rules uniform across the country.

title: Who’s Who in Iran? Guide to the Islamic Republic’s Top Leaders
title_cn: 伊朗的名人是谁？伊斯兰共和国最高领导人指南
summary: The US-Israeli war against Iran has upended the Islamic Republic’s sprawling state apparatus.

title: Who Really Runs Zimbabwe? This $20 Million Wedding Holds the Answer.
title_cn: 谁真正统治着津巴布韦？这场耗资 2000 万美元的婚礼给出了答案。
summary: In late May, Zimbabwe’s one percent gathered at a polo club on the outskirts of Harare to celebrate the marriage of one of their own.

title: Kosovo, Ukraine Ties Sour as Zelenskyy Sticks to Non-Recognition
title_cn: 泽伦斯基坚持不承认科索沃和乌克兰关系恶化
summary: A giant “Free Ukraine” banner that had hung in the center of Kosovo’s capital for more than four years was removed after Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said this weekend that Kyiv’s position on Kosovo’s independence remains unchanged.

title: Zimbabwe Divided by Wealthy’s Sway Over Politics Under Mnangagwa
title_cn: 姆南加古瓦领导下的富人对政治的影响导致津巴布韦分裂
summary: A lavish Harare wedding attended by the president shows the political clout wielded by tycoons.
